  s.specobjid AS matched_specobjid,

    WHEN s.specobjid = p.objid THEN 'specobjid'

specobj_identity AS (
SELECT
  s.specobjid::numeric AS specobjid,
  s.bestobjid::bigint AS bestobjid,
  s.plate::smallint AS plate,
  s.mjd::integer AS mjd,
  s.fiberid::smallint AS fiberid,
  s.class::varchar AS class,
  s.z::real AS z
FROM specobj s

photoobj_basic_pos_mag AS (

  objid AS object_id,
  ra,
  dec,
  u,
  g,
  r,
  i,
  z,

  COALESCE(NULLIF(clean,0)::integer, 0) AS clean,

    s.class AS spec_class,
    s.subclass AS spec_subclass
  FROM photoobj p

photoobj_as_record AS (
  SELECT
    objid,
    run,
    rerun,
    field,
    mode,
    type,
    clean,
    ra,
    dec,
    u,
    g,
    r,
    i,
    z,
    cmodelmag_u,
    cmodelmag_g,
    cmodelmag_r,
    extinction_r
  FROM photoobj
),
photo_type_lookup_12 AS (
  SELECT
    value,
    name,
    description
  FROM photo_type
),
photoobj_core_photometry AS (
  SELECT
    p.objid,
    p.ra,
    p.dec,
    p.u,
    p.g,
    p.r,
    p.i,
    p.z,
    p.cmodelmag_r,
    p.type,
    -- normalize clean to boolean-like integer: 1 when clean is nonzero (not null and not 0), else 0
    CASE
      WHEN p.clean IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN p.clean = 0 THEN 0

  FROM photoobj_as_record AS p

SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  p.cmodelmag_r,

  CASE WHEN p.g IS NOT NULL AND p.r IS NOT NULL THEN (p.g - p.r) ELSE NULL END AS g_minus_r,
  CASE WHEN p.i IS NOT NULL AND p.z IS NOT NULL THEN (p.i - p.z) ELSE NULL END AS i_minus_z,
  -- validity flag: true if u,g,r,i,z and cmodelmag_u/g/r are all non-null (per requirement: "has_ugri_z_nonnull" indicate non-NULLness of the inputs;

photoobj_spatial_index_basic AS (
